name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Aldric does not belong to the Ironmongers' Guild if and only if the artisan in Bridgegate belongs to the Ironmongers' Guild.
Bridgegate, Riverside, and Southgate go with Aldric, Cedric, and Matilda, in some order.
Exactly two of (the members of the River Ward, Godfrey, and Matilda) go with (Blacksmith or Tanner).
Either Mason goes with Matilda or someone in the River Ward goes with Mason (but not both).
Between Cedric and Matilda, one goes with Bridgegate and the other with Riverside.
Exactly one of these is true: Aldric goes with Eastcheap; Matilda goes with Tanner; Blacksmith goes with Eastcheap.
